title: Perps — ensure a venue active on a chosen network (idempotent, venue-generic)
description: Converges to '<provider> active on the requested network' using ensure semantics: wallet unlocked, Perps entered, provider and network switched ONLY when they differ from the request (the underlying action reports changed:false on a no-op), signer readiness asserted. Re-running when already converged performs no switches — cheap enough to prefix every unit.

ensure-venue.intent: Converge to the requested venue and network — switching only if the app is not already there — and prove the venue signer is ready to trade.
